outcome: Quality of Maternal and Newborn Care (QMNC) index
cohort: 25,206 women who gave birth in 16 European countries within the WHO European Region between March 2020 and February 2022.
finding: Births in private facilities showed significantly higher odds of cesarean compared to public facilities.
mod_finding: Women giving birth in private facilities reported significantly more frequent total, elective, and emergency cesarean births compared to those in public facilities.
